title: Three-Dimensional Quantification of Spheroid Degradation-Dependent Invasion and Invadopodia Formation
author: Goertzen, Eymael, et al.
materials: Chill paraffin-embedded tissue blocks on ice before sectioning.
Counterstain in Lithium carbonate solution (1 min).

Leibowitz’s L-15 Medium, no phenol red (21083027, ThermoFisher) supplemented with 10% (v/v) fetal bovine serum. L-15 medium is buffered by phosphates and free base amino acids instead of sodium bicarbonate, alleviating the need for 5% CO2 during the live cell imaging. The absence of phenol red in L-15 is used to prevent phenol red autofluorescence during immunofluorescence image acquisition. Plastic paraffin film (Parafilm). Cell culture growth media (Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM; Thermo Fisher Scientific) supplemented with 10% (v/v) fetal bovine serum (FBS; Thermo Fisher Scientific), non-essential amino acids (100 nmol/L; Thermo Fisher Scientific), penicillin and streptomycin liquid (100 mg/mL; Thermo Fisher Scientific). Ligands and inhibitors (#8902sf, Cell signaling) and GM6001 (M5939 Millipore)). Spinning disk confocal microscopy (Quorum spinning disk confocal, Leica DMIRE2). We used Volocity 6.3 to analyze the 3D images generated from the spheroids. Using Volocity we were able to accurately select the BODIPY-green signal using the standard deviation of the pixel intensity and analyze volume, intensity, shape (circularity, roundness).

4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA). Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS). Ethanol (50%, 70%, 80%, 95%, 100%). Ethanol: Xylene (2:1, 1:1; 1:2). Xylene (100%). Xylene: Paraffin (2:1, 1:1, 1:2). Paraffin (100%). Paraffin oven. Paraffin cassettes. Rotary Microtome (Leica RM2125 RTS). Superfrost Plus Microscope Slides 15x75x1.0 mm (Fisherbrand, # 12–550 15). TRIS-buffered saline (TBS) plus 0.025% Triton X-100. 1% (Bovine serum albumin) BSA in TBS. Primary Antibodies (Cortactin (ab84208, Abcam), Tks5 (ab118575, Abcam Biotechnology), MMP-14 (ab56307, Abcam). Secondary Antibodies (Donkey F(ab’)2 Anti-Goat IgG H&L (Alexa Fluor 647) (ab150139, Abcam), Donkey F(ab’)2 Anti-Rabbit IgG H&L (Alexa fluoro-568) (ab175694, Abcam), Donkey F(ab’)2 Anti-Mouse IgG H&L 488 (ab150155, Abcam). DAPI (NucBlue Fixed Cell Ready Probes reagent, Life technologies - Catalog# R37606). Distilled water. Harris Hematoxylin solution. Lithium carbonate solution. 5% Eosin solution. Mounting medium (ProLong diamond Antifade Mount, Life technologies, #P36961). Coverslips (22mmX50mm 1.5 oz. cover class, Electron Microscopy Sciences Sciences. Catalog#72204–04. ZEISS ELYRA PS.1 super-resolution microscopy, Quorum Spinning Disk Confocal microscope. Imaging analyzing software: ZEISS ZEN 2.3 and Volocity 6.3.

steps.title: Culture tumor cells to confluency
steps.instruction: Grow tumor cells (e.g., MDA‑MB‑231 or UMSCC1) in a T75 flask with DMEM + 10 % (v/v) FBS at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until the monolayer reaches 60–80 % confluency.

steps.title: Wash monolayers with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml PBS per 75 cm² of flask surface, gently swirl, and discard to remove culture medium.

steps.title: Trypsinize and neutralize cells
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml trypsin per 75 cm², incubate 4–10 min until cells detach, then add 8 ml DMEM + 10 % FBS to inactivate trypsin and transfer the suspension to a 15 ml conical tube.

steps.title: Collect and count cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 RCF for 5 min, aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 ml DMEM + 10 % FBS using a P1000, count with a hemocytometer and dilute to 50 0000 cells / ml.

steps.title: Seed cells into ultra‑low plates
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µl (5 000 cells) of the suspension into each well of a Corning round‑bottom Ultra‑Low Attachment 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Form spheroids in incubator
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator and culture until spheroids appear (≈24–72 h).

steps.title: Cool tips and plate overnight
steps.instruction: Cool pipette tips of sizes 0.1–2.0 µl, 2–200 µl, and 100–1000 µl, as well as a 96‑well flat‑bottom plate, at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Thaw and aliquot Geltrex
steps.instruction: Thaw Geltrex™ on ice for 45–60 min until liquid, then dispense 100 µl per condition into chilled 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tubes (e.g., 300 µl for three spheroids).

steps.title: Embed spheroids in Geltrex
steps.instruction: At the desired time point, gently remove 100 µl culture medium from each well and add 100 µl Leibowitz’s L‑15 phenol‑red‑free medium + 10 % FBS; then overlay each spheroid with 100 µl liquid Geltrex from the prepared tube and keep on ice.

steps.title: Seal plate and image live degradation
steps.instruction: Wrap the plate perimeter with Parafilm, locate each spheroid by confocal microscopy, acquire bright‑field and 505 nm excitation (green‑BSA 515 nm emission) z‑stacks at 1 µm intervals to capture Geltrex degradation.

steps.title: Add ligands/inhibitors and incubate
steps.instruction: Remove Parafilm, replace L‑15 medium with 100 µl culture medium containing the desired ligands or inhibitors, and incubate spheroids at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Fix spheroids with paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Using a P200, aspirate 100 µl medium, wash once with 100 µl PBS, add 150 µl room‑temperature 3.7 % paraformaldehyde, and store the plate at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Wash and store after fixation
steps.instruction: Remove PFA with a P200, wash each well three times with 100 µl PBS, add 100 µl PBS and keep at 4 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Dehydrate through ethanol series
steps.instruction: Remove PBS and sequentially add 100 µl per well of 50 % ethanol (10 min), 70 % ethanol (10 min), 80 % ethanol (10 min), 95 % ethanol (10 min), then 100 % ethanol four times (each 10 min).

steps.title: Clear with xylene series
steps.instruction: Exchange ethanol for xylene by adding 100 µl per well of 2:1 ethanol:xylene (15 min), 1:1 (15 min), 1:2 (15 min), then 100 % xylene twice (each 15 min).

steps.title: Infiltrate with paraffin and embed
steps.instruction: In a paraffin oven set to 54–58 °C, treat each well with 100 µl of 2:1 xylene:paraffin (30 min), 1:1 (30 min), 1:2 (30 min), then 100 % paraffin for 2 h followed by overnight; embed the tissue in fresh paraffin, orient in a cassette, and chill blocks on ice.

steps.title: Section paraffin blocks at 5 µm
steps.instruction: Fill a water bath with ultrapure water at 45 °C, cut 5 µm sections using a rotary microtome, float sections on the water bath, lift onto Superfrost Plus slides, and dry overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence staining of sections
steps.instruction: For each slide: (1) wash 3 × 5 min with TBS + 0.025 % Triton X‑100 on a gentle shaker; (2) block with 1 % BSA in TBS for 2 h at room temperature; (3) incubate with primary antibodies (cortactin, Tks5, MMP‑14) diluted in TBS + 1 % BSA overnight at 4 °C; (4) wash 3 × 5 min as before; (5) incubate with appropriate secondary antibodies diluted in TBS + 1 % BSA overnight at 4 °C; (6) wash 3 × 5 min; (7) counterstain with DAPI (1 µg ml⁻¹) in TBS + 1 % BSA for 60 min at room temperature protected from light; (8) wash 3 × 5 min; (9) mount with antifade medium, add a coverslip, and dry at room temperature for 24 h.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images of stained sections
steps.instruction: Using a confocal microscope, image each section with 488 nm (MMP‑14), 568 nm (cortactin), 647 nm (Tks5), and 405 nm (DAPI) excitation; collect z‑stacks at 0.1 µm intervals from bottom to top.

steps.title: Analyze 3D volumes and invadopodia
steps.instruction: Process the image stacks with Volocity 6.3 (or ZEISS ZEN 2.3/Imaris): trace spheroid bright‑field images for total volume, trace 515 nm green signal for Geltrex degradation volume, and assess colocalization of cortactin + Tks5 (precursor invadopodia) and cortactin + MMP‑14 (mature invadopodia). Report volumes in µm³; optionally normalize degradation volume to day 1.

steps.title: Optional H&E staining of sections
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize slides in 100 % xylene (3 min × 3), re‑hydrate through 100 % ethanol (2 min × 3), 95 % ethanol (2 min × 2), 70 % ethanol (2 min × 2), wash in distilled water (2 min × 2), stain in Harris Hematoxylin (7 min), wash (2 min), differentiate in 0.5–1 % acid alcohol (3 dips), wash (1 min), counterstain in Lithium carbonate (1 min), wash (2 min × 2), dip in 5 % Eosin (1 dip), dehydrate through 95 % ethanol (30 s × 2) and 100 % ethanol (30 s × 2), clear in xylene (2 min × 3), mount with mounting medium, coverslip, dry 24 h at room temperature, and image by light microscopy.
